design.board_rules: n x n grid, n orthogonally connected regions; one queen per row, column and region; queens may not touch, including diagonally.

generators.solution_first_growth: Sample a non-touching permutation by randomized backtracking; seed one region per queen; grow by randomized weighted frontier growth (log-normal region weights); repair to uniqueness by moving cells of alternative solutions into adjacent regions (donor stays connected with >= 2 cells; planted queens never move; at most 60 moves).
generators.partition_first_voronoi: Choose n random seed cells; assign other cells to the seed minimizing weighted Manhattan distance plus noise; release disconnected fragments and re-grow them from neighbours; no planted solution; keep only if uniquely solvable (pure rejection, no repair).

design.candidate_parameters: Each candidate's RNG draws locked_singletons (0 with probability 1/2, else 1 with probability 0.6, else 2) and weight_sigma in [0.2, 1.5]. These only bias shapes; strata are computed from the finished board.
design.certification: Solver (i) row-by-row column backtracking and solver (ii) bitmask region DFS with minimum remaining values must both report exactly one solution and the same solution; replay.solutions is checked again at prepare time. Every region must be orthogonally connected.
design.labels: Region ids are relabelled by first appearance in row-major order (historical convention), so labels carry no generator or solution order.
design.symmetry: Canonical form = minimum over the 8 rotations/reflections of the grid relabelled by first appearance in row-major order. Candidates whose canonical form equals a historical board, a development board or an earlier accepted panel board are rejected.
design.node_definition: A node is one tentative queen placement passing the solver's constraint checks. Row solver: rows top to bottom, columns left to right. MRV solver: region with fewest available cells (ties lowest id), cells row-major. nodes_first counts until the first solution; nodes_uniqueness counts until exhaustion with a two-solution limit.
design.tier_metric: Mean over the 8 dihedral orientations of log2(row-solver uniqueness nodes), so the tier does not depend on board orientation.
design.strata: singleton status (>= 1 single-cell region vs none) x tier (tier metric <= vs > the median of the development pool for the same size and singleton status).
design.quotas: 64 boards per size: 16 per stratum, 8 per generator per stratum. Phase 1 fills each generator's own quotas. Phase 2 (top-up) lets the other generator fill a stratum that a generator could not fill within its budget, recorded as top_up=true. Remaining gaps are recorded as shortfalls, never substituted from another stratum.
design.propagation: Simple propagation: a region, row or column with exactly one candidate cell forces a queen; each queen eliminates its row, column, region and 8 neighbours; rounds repeat until nothing is forced.
design.greedy: Unplaced region with the fewest immediately legal cells (ties lowest id), first legal cell row-major, no backtracking; oracle only scores.
design.uniform_random_completion: Exact DP: uniform unoccupied region, then uniform cell from the raw (all region cells) or local (immediately legal) menu; success only if every placement is on the unique solution.
design.exploration_disclosure: Generator shapes and the tier rule were chosen after exploratory runs with master seeds 1 and 2, which are not part of any corpus. The development pool (DEV_SEED) and panel (PANEL_SEED) were generated after the rule was fixed.

solutions: Not included. Each board has solution_sha256 = sha256 of the compact JSON 1-based column vector; solutions are stored only in the ignored private input file. The board uniquely determines its solution, so the hash is an integrity commitment, not secrecy.
